note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The story asks for a prompt on scheduled sending and update. There is no scheduling feature: the particulars update and the SMS/email sending run immediately when the OIC confirms, so the on-screen prompt only reports the result of the immediate execution. The success and failure prompts for the update exist and are clear; the send-result prompt is generic text only. To verify [Low confidence]: ManualReviewService.approveSubmission sets the status to 'A' (lines 363-366) before addFurnishedOffender (376) and changeProcessingStage (379), then catches every exception and returns failure without rethrowing (434-437); whether the early change is rolled back cannot be confirmed from the repo. Real email delivery over SMTP: cannot verify from repo; email.enableSmtp=true in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/application.properties:133 and there is no override in application-prod.properties. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Claim partially: the success and failure prompts for the particulars update exist, but scheduled sending is not built and the send-result prompt gives no detail. Ask URA whether immediate execution is accepted in place of scheduling.

steps.step: OIC confirms the decision in the Submit dialog, then the system runs the particulars update and the SMS/email sending (story: scheduled)
steps.detail: The confirmation dialog 'Do you wish to proceed ...' (ActionNotice.tsx:189-210) calls onSaveSubmit on OK (ActionNotice.tsx:313-317), which immediately calls approveFurnish/rejectFurnish and then composeFurnish in one chain (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:198-216). There is no send date/time or scheduled job: ManualReviewService.sendEmail calls notificationService.sendAndRecordEmail straight away (ManualReviewService.java:503), and a grep for 'schedul' in furnish/manualreview, approval, rejection, the Furnish pages and the Notice hooks of ocmsadminui finds nothing. The story asks for the sending and update to be scheduled; the code executes them at once.

steps.step: OCMS shows an on-screen prompt that the particulars update succeeded
steps.detail: When the approve/reject succeeds, onSaveSubmit opens a non-error ModalAlert (isError false) with 'Furnished particulars has been saved as the Current Hirer/Driver.' or 'Furnish rejected successfully.' (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:210-212; ActionNotice.tsx:260-267). After the OIC closes it the page reloads (ActionNotice.tsx:268-272) so the latest status is read. The prompt reports the result of the immediate execution, not of a schedule.

steps.step: OCMS shows a prompt with the SMS/email sending result
steps.detail: If a compose_list exists, composeFurnish is called and the success message gets '... email/SMS has been sent to the recipient' appended (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:223-225). If some or all sends fail, the UI only writes 'Email/SMS was not successfully sent to the recipient(s).' (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:218-220): the per-recipient error list collected by composeFurnish (useFurnishAPI.ts:193-197) is not shown, so the OIC does not know which recipient failed or why. This prompt is also not a 'schedule sent' status as in the story. The server records the send result in the email notification records with status S/E (FurnishNotificationService.java:50-90) but it is not shown in the prompt.

steps.step: OCMS shows an error prompt when the particulars update fails, and the email/SMS is not sent
steps.detail: If the approve endpoint returns an error (e.g. 422 from approveSubmission, ManualReviewController.java:197-201), useNoticeSubmit writes 'Furnished particulars could not be saved as the Current <Hirer/Driver> due to <error>. Email/SMS was not sent.' and composeFurnish is not called (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:202-207). onSaveSubmit throws that error and opens an error ModalAlert (ActionNotice.tsx:243-245, 276-285).
